import * as fs from "fs";
import * as path from "path";
import * as os from "os";
import * as child_process from "child_process";
import { promisify } from "util";
import AdmZip from "adm-zip";
const execAsync = promisify(child_process.exec);
// Configuration
const APPSCAN_API_BASE = process.env.APPSCAN_API_BASE || "https://cloud.appscan.com";
const APPSCAN_KEY_ID = process.env.APPSCAN_KEY_ID;
const APPSCAN_KEY_SECRET = process.env.APPSCAN_KEY_SECRET;
function getDirectApiKeyHeader() {
    if (!APPSCAN_KEY_ID || !APPSCAN_KEY_SECRET) {
        throw new Error("AppScan credentials are not configured. Set APPSCAN_KEY_ID and APPSCAN_KEY_SECRET.");
    }
    return `${APPSCAN_KEY_ID}:${APPSCAN_KEY_SECRET}`;
}
const SCAN_EXECUTION_SELECT = "Id,Status,Progress,ExecutionDurationSec,Result,Risk,NCriticalIssues,NHighIssues,NMediumIssues,NLowIssues,NInfoIssues";
function truncateForLog(value, maxLength = 4000) {
    const text = String(value || "").trim();
    if (text.length <= maxLength)
        return text;
    return `${text.slice(0, maxLength)}\n... output truncated ...`;
}
function toMinimalExecution(execution) {
    if (!execution)
        return null;
    return {
        Id: execution.Id,
        Status: execution.Status,
        Progress: execution.Progress,
        ExecutionDurationSec: execution.ExecutionDurationSec,
        Result: execution.Result,
        Risk: execution.Risk,
        NCriticalIssues: execution.NCriticalIssues,
        NHighIssues: execution.NHighIssues,
        NMediumIssues: execution.NMediumIssues,
        NLowIssues: execution.NLowIssues,
        NInfoIssues: execution.NInfoIssues,
    };
}
function toMinimalScanData(scanData) {
    if (!scanData)
        return null;
    return {
        Id: scanData.Id || scanData.ScanId,
        Name: scanData.Name || scanData.ScanName,
        Created: scanData.Created || scanData.CreatedAt,
        CreatedAt: scanData.CreatedAt,
        LatestExecution: toMinimalExecution(scanData.LatestExecution),
    };
}
/**
 * Validate that direct API key credentials are available.
 */
export async function ensureAuth() {
    return Boolean(APPSCAN_KEY_ID && APPSCAN_KEY_SECRET);
}
/**
 * Minimal fetch wrapper for AppScan API.
 */
export async function makeAppScanRequest(endpoint, opts = {}) {
    const url = `${APPSCAN_API_BASE}${endpoint}`;
    const headers = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "X-Api-Key": getDirectApiKeyHeader(),
        ...(opts.headers || {}),
    };
    const resp = await fetch(url, { method: opts.method || "GET", body: opts.body, headers });
    if (!resp.ok) {
        const text = await resp.text();
        throw new Error(`HTTP ${resp.status}: ${text}`);
    }
    const ct = resp.headers.get("content-type") || "";
    if (ct.includes("application/json"))
        return (await resp.json());
    return {};
}
/**
 * Poll scan status until it is Ready or Abort.
 */
export async function waitForScanReady(scanId, intervalMs = 15000, progressCallback, detailedLogs = false) {
    let status = "Unknown";
    let lastPayload = null;
    const start = Date.now();
    let lastReportedProgress = -1;
    let lastElapsedReportAt = start;
    let selectFailed = false;
    while (!["Ready", "Abort"].includes(status)) {
        const selectedEndpoint = `/api/v4/Scans/${scanId}/Executions?$top=1&$select=${SCAN_EXECUTION_SELECT}`;
        const fallbackEndpoint = `/api/v4/Scans/${scanId}/Executions?$top=1`;
        let executions;
        try {
            executions = await makeAppScanRequest(selectFailed ? fallbackEndpoint : selectedEndpoint);
        }
        catch (error) {
            if (selectFailed)
                throw error;
            selectFailed = true;
            console.error(`[scanService] Execution field selection failed, falling back to minimal local projection: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
            executions = await makeAppScanRequest(fallbackEndpoint);
        }
        // The latest execution is the first one in the array
        const latestExecution = executions && executions.length > 0 ? toMinimalExecution(executions[0]) : null;
        lastPayload = latestExecution;
        status = latestExecution?.Status || "Unknown";
        const progress = latestExecution?.Progress || 0;
        // Report progress when it changes significantly or on a bounded elapsed interval.
        const elapsed = Date.now() - start;
        const progressStep = detailedLogs ? 1 : 10;
        const elapsedReportMs = detailedLogs ? 120000 : 300000;
        const shouldReport = (progress - lastReportedProgress >= progressStep) ||
            (Date.now() - lastElapsedReportAt >= elapsedReportMs);
        if (shouldReport && progressCallback) {
            const elapsedMin = Math.floor(elapsed / 60000);
            const message = `⏳ Scan in progress: ${progress}% complete (status: ${status}, elapsed: ${elapsedMin}m)`;
            const result = progressCallback(message, 95 + Math.min(progress / 20, 4), 100);
            // Handle both sync and async callbacks
            if (result instanceof Promise) {
                await result;
            }
            lastReportedProgress = progress;
            lastElapsedReportAt = Date.now();
        }
        // Also log to console.error for debugging
        if (shouldReport) {
            console.error(`[scanService] Scan status=${status}, progress=${progress}%, elapsed=${Math.floor(elapsed / 60000)}m`);
        }
        if (!["Ready", "Abort"].includes(status)) {
            await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, intervalMs));
        }
    }
    return { status, lastPayload };
}
/**
 * Download and extract SAClientUtil to ~/.appscan directory.
 * Returns the path to the appscan executable.
 */
export async function downloadSAClient() {
    console.error("[scanService] Checking SAClientUtil version...");
    // Detect platform and set appropriate OS and executable name
    const platform = os.platform();
    const isWindows = platform === "win32";
    const isMac = platform === "darwin";
    // Available options: "Win", "Linux", "Mac", "WinGui", "LinuxGui", "MacGui"
    let osParam;
    if (isWindows) {
        osParam = "Win";
    }
    else if (isMac) {
        osParam = "Mac";
    }
    else {
        osParam = "Linux";
    }
    const executableName = isWindows ? "appscan.bat" : "appscan.sh";
    // Step 1: Check the latest version from the API
    const metaUrl = `${APPSCAN_API_BASE}/api/v4/Tools/SAClientUtilByType?toolType=${osParam}&meta=true`;
    console.error(`[scanService] Fetching latest version info from: ${metaUrl}`);
    let latestVersion = null;
    try {
        const metaResponse = await fetch(metaUrl);
        if (metaResponse.ok) {
            const metaData = await metaResponse.json();
            latestVersion = metaData?.VersionNumber || metaData?.VersionNumber || null;
            console.error(`[scanService] Latest version from API: ${latestVersion}`);
        }
        else {
            console.error(`[scanService] Warning: Failed to fetch version metadata (HTTP ${metaResponse.status}), will proceed with download`);
        }
    }
    catch (error) {
        console.error(`[scanService] Warning: Failed to fetch version metadata: ${error}, will proceed with download`);
    }
    // Step 2: Check if the latest version already exists locally
    const homeDir = os.homedir();
    const appscanBaseDir = path.join(homeDir, ".appscan");
    if (latestVersion && fs.existsSync(appscanBaseDir)) {
        // Look for directory matching the latest version (e.g., SAClientUtil.8.0.1677)
        const expectedDirName = `SAClientUtil.${latestVersion}`;
        const expectedPath = path.join(appscanBaseDir, expectedDirName);
        if (fs.existsSync(expectedPath)) {
            console.error(`[scanService] Latest version ${latestVersion} already exists at ${expectedPath}`);
            const appscanPath = path.join(expectedPath, "bin", executableName);
            if (fs.existsSync(appscanPath)) {
                const normalizedPath = isWindows ? path.normalize(appscanPath) : appscanPath;
                console.error(`[scanService] Using existing SAClientUtil: ${normalizedPath}`);
                return normalizedPath;
            }
            else {
                console.error(`[scanService] Warning: Expected executable not found at ${appscanPath}, will re-download`);
            }
        }
        else {
            console.error(`[scanService] Latest version ${latestVersion} not found locally, downloading...`);
        }
    }
    // Step 3: Download SAClientUtil if not already present
    console.error("[scanService] Downloading SAClientUtil...");
    const url = `${APPSCAN_API_BASE}/api/v4/Tools/SAClientUtil?os=${osParam}`;
    console.error(`[scanService] Platform: ${platform}, OS param: ${osParam}`);
    // Download SAClientUtil zip to temp location
    const tempZipPath = path.join(os.tmpdir(), `saclient-${Date.now()}.zip`);
    const response = await fetch(url);
    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(`Failed to download SAClientUtil: HTTP ${response.status}`);
    }
    // Verify content-type
    const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || '';
    if (!contentType.toLowerCase().includes('application/zip')) {
        console.error(`[scanService] Unexpected content-type: ${contentType}`);
        throw new Error(`Downloaded file is not a zip. Content-Type: ${contentType}`);
    }
    // Save zip file
    const buffer = await response.arrayBuffer();
    fs.writeFileSync(tempZipPath, Buffer.from(buffer));
    console.error(`[scanService] Downloaded ${(buffer.byteLength / 1048576).toFixed(2)}MB`);
    // Extract zip to temp location to detect version
    console.error("[scanService] Extracting SAClientUtil...");
    const tempExtractDir = path.join(os.tmpdir(), `saclient-extract-${Date.now()}`);
    try {
        const zip = new AdmZip(tempZipPath);
        zip.extractAllTo(tempExtractDir, true);
    }
    catch (error) {
        console.error(`[scanService] Zip extraction failed: ${error}`);
        const sample = fs.readFileSync(tempZipPath).slice(0, 200);
        console.error(`[scanService] First 200 bytes of file: ${sample.toString('hex')}`);
        fs.unlinkSync(tempZipPath);
        throw new Error(`Downloaded file is not a valid zip file`);
    }
    // Find extracted directory (should be SAClientUtil.x.x.xxxx)
    const extractedDirs = fs.readdirSync(tempExtractDir).filter(d => {
        const fullPath = path.join(tempExtractDir, d);
        try {
            return fs.statSync(fullPath).isDirectory();
        }
        catch {
            return false;
        }
    });
    if (extractedDirs.length === 0) {
        throw new Error("SAClientUtil extraction failed - no directories found");
    }
    const extractedDirName = extractedDirs[0]; // e.g., SAClientUtil.8.0.1677
    console.error(`[scanService] Detected version directory: ${extractedDirName}`);
    // Set up ~/.appscan directory structure (reuse variables already declared above)
    const saclientDir = path.join(appscanBaseDir, extractedDirName);
    // Check if already exists
    if (fs.existsSync(saclientDir)) {
        console.error(`[scanService] SAClientUtil already exists at ${saclientDir}`);
        // Clean up temp files
        fs.unlinkSync(tempZipPath);
        fs.rmSync(tempExtractDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
    }
    else {
        // Create .appscan directory if needed
        if (!fs.existsSync(appscanBaseDir)) {
            fs.mkdirSync(appscanBaseDir, { recursive: true });
        }
        // Move extracted directory to ~/.appscan
        const tempSaclientPath = path.join(tempExtractDir, extractedDirName);
        fs.renameSync(tempSaclientPath, saclientDir);
        console.error(`[scanService] Installed SAClientUtil to ${saclientDir}`);
        // Clean up temp files
        fs.unlinkSync(tempZipPath);
        fs.rmSync(tempExtractDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
    }
    const appscanPath = path.join(saclientDir, "bin", executableName);
    if (!fs.existsSync(appscanPath)) {
        throw new Error(`AppScan executable not found at ${appscanPath}`);
    }
    // Normalize path for Windows to use backslashes
    const normalizedPath = isWindows ? path.normalize(appscanPath) : appscanPath;
    // Set execute permissions (Linux/Mac only)
    if (!isWindows) {
        try {
            // Set permissions recursively for all files
            const setPermissionsRecursive = (dir) => {
                const items = fs.readdirSync(dir);
                for (const item of items) {
                    const fullPath = path.join(dir, item);
                    const stat = fs.statSync(fullPath);
                    if (stat.isDirectory()) {
                        fs.chmodSync(fullPath, 0o755);
                        setPermissionsRecursive(fullPath);
                    }
                    else {
                        fs.chmodSync(fullPath, 0o755);
                    }
                }
            };
            setPermissionsRecursive(saclientDir);
        }
        catch (error) {
            console.error(`[scanService] Warning: Failed to set permissions: ${error}`);
        }
    }
    console.error(`[scanService] SAClient ready at ${normalizedPath}`);
    return normalizedPath;
}
/**
 * Generate IRX file using SAClientUtil.
 */
export async function generateIRX(appscanPath, targetDir, scanName, outputDir, configFile, scanFlag, secretScanning, scanLevel, analysisOnly, detailedLogs = false) {
    console.error("[scanService] Generating IRX file...");
    const irxFile = `${scanName}.irx`;
    const isWindows = os.platform() === "win32";
    // Create output directory with timestamp if not specified
    const actualOutputDir = outputDir || path.join(targetDir, `HCLAppScan_${new Date().toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, '_').split('.')[0]}`);
    if (!fs.existsSync(actualOutputDir)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(actualOutputDir, { recursive: true });
    }
    const irxPath = path.join(actualOutputDir, irxFile);
    // Normalize paths for Windows - use path.normalize() for consistency
    const normalizedAppscanPath = isWindows ? path.normalize(appscanPath) : appscanPath;
    const normalizedConfigFile = configFile && isWindows ? path.normalize(configFile) : configFile;
    const normalizedOutputDir = isWindows ? path.normalize(actualOutputDir) : actualOutputDir;
    // Build command
    let cmd = `"${normalizedAppscanPath}" prepare`;
    if (normalizedConfigFile && fs.existsSync(configFile)) {
        cmd += ` -c "${normalizedConfigFile}"`;
    }
    // Add -d flag for output directory
    cmd += ` -d "${normalizedOutputDir}"`;
    // Add -n flag for IRX filename
    cmd += ` -n "${irxFile}"`;
    // Add -sao flag for scan-only analysis if specified
    if (analysisOnly) {
        cmd += ` -sao`;
    }
    // Add -s flag for scan level
    if (scanLevel) {
        cmd += ` -s ${scanLevel}`;
    }
    if (scanFlag) {
        cmd += ` ${scanFlag}`;
    }
    if (secretScanning) {
        cmd += ` -ssc`;
    }
    if (detailedLogs) {
        cmd += ` -v`;
    }
    console.error(`[scanService] Running: ${cmd}`);
    console.error(`[scanService] Working directory: ${targetDir}`);
    try {
        const execOptions = {
            cwd: targetDir,
            maxBuffer: 1024 * 1024 * 10, // 10MB buffer
            windowsHide: true,
            env: { ...process.env }, // Inherit all environment variables
        };
        // On Windows, wrap the command with cmd.exe /c for proper batch file execution
        let finalCmd = cmd;
        if (isWindows) {
            finalCmd = `cmd.exe /c "${cmd}"`;
            execOptions.shell = 'cmd.exe';
        }
        const { stdout, stderr } = await execAsync(finalCmd, execOptions);
        if (detailedLogs && stdout)
            console.error(`[scanService] stdout: ${truncateForLog(stdout, 12000)}`);
        if (detailedLogs && stderr)
            console.error(`[scanService] stderr: ${truncateForLog(stderr, 12000)}`);
        if (!fs.existsSync(irxPath)) {
            throw new Error(`IRX file not generated at ${irxPath}`);
        }
        const stats = fs.statSync(irxPath);
        console.error(`[scanService] IRX generated: ${irxPath} (${(stats.size / 1048576).toFixed(2)}MB)`);
        return irxPath;
    }
    catch (error) {
        const output = [error?.stdout, error?.stderr].filter(Boolean).map((value) => truncateForLog(value, 2000)).join("\n");
        if (output) {
            console.error(`[scanService] IRX generation output excerpt:\n${output}`);
        }
        throw new Error(`IRX generation failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
    }
}
/**
 * Upload IRX file to AppScan and get fileId.
 */
export async function uploadIRXFile(irxPath) {
    console.error("[scanService] Uploading IRX file...");
    if (!fs.existsSync(irxPath)) {
        throw new Error(`IRX file not found: ${irxPath}`);
    }
    const fileBuffer = fs.readFileSync(irxPath);
    const fileName = path.basename(irxPath);
    // Create multipart form data
    const boundary = `----Boundary${Date.now()}`;
    const chunks = [];
    chunks.push(Buffer.from(`--${boundary}\r\n`));
    chunks.push(Buffer.from(`Content-Disposition: form-data; name="uploadedFile"; filename="${fileName}"\r\n`));
    chunks.push(Buffer.from(`Content-Type: application/octet-stream\r\n\r\n`));
    chunks.push(fileBuffer);
    chunks.push(Buffer.from(`\r\n--${boundary}--\r\n`));
    const body = Buffer.concat(chunks);
    const response = await fetch(`${APPSCAN_API_BASE}/api/v4/FileUpload`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
            "X-Api-Key": getDirectApiKeyHeader(),
            "Content-Type": `multipart/form-data; boundary=${boundary}`,
        },
        body,
    });
    if (!response.ok) {
        const errorText = await response.text();
        throw new Error(`File upload failed: HTTP ${response.status} - ${errorText}`);
    }
    const result = await response.json();
    const fileId = result.FileId || result.Id;
    if (!fileId) {
        throw new Error("File upload did not return a FileId");
    }
    console.error(`[scanService] File uploaded. FileId: ${fileId}`);
    return fileId;
}
/**
 * Create a new scan in AppScan.
 */
export async function createScan(appId, scanName, fileId, scanType, comment) {
    console.error("[scanService] Creating scan...");
    const endpoint = scanType === "SAST" ? "/api/v4/Scans/Sast" : "/api/v4/Scans/Sca";
    const payload = {
        AppId: appId,
        ApplicationFileId: fileId,
        EnableMailNotification: false,
        Execute: true,
        Locale: "en",
        Personal: false,
        ScanName: scanName,
        FullyAutomatic: true,
        ClientType: "MCP-Copilot"
    };
    if (comment)
        payload.Comment = comment;
    const createRes = await makeAppScanRequest(endpoint, {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });
    const scanId = createRes?.Id || createRes?.ScanId;
    if (!scanId) {
        throw new Error("Scan creation did not return an ID");
    }
    return { scanId, scanData: toMinimalScanData(createRes) };
}
/**
 * Format scan summary from scan data.
 */
export function formatScanSummary(scanId, scanName, scanType, scanData, irxPath, fileId) {
    // Support both scan data with LatestExecution and execution data directly
    const execution = scanData?.LatestExecution || scanData;
    const summaryLines = [
        `Scan ID: ${scanId}`,
        `Name: ${scanData?.Name || scanName}`,
        `Type: ${scanType}`,
        `Status: ${execution?.Status || "Unknown"}`,
        `Created: ${scanData?.Created || scanData?.CreatedAt || "Unknown"}`,
        `DurationSec: ${execution?.ExecutionDurationSec ?? "Unknown"}`,
        `Risk: ${execution?.Risk || execution?.Result || "Unknown"}`,
        `Critical: ${execution?.NCriticalIssues ?? 0}`,
        `High: ${execution?.NHighIssues ?? 0}`,
        `Medium: ${execution?.NMediumIssues ?? 0}`,
        `Low: ${execution?.NLowIssues ?? 0}`,
        `Info: ${execution?.NInfoIssues ?? 0}`,
        `---`,
        `IRX Path: ${irxPath}`,
        `FileId: ${fileId}`,
    ];
    return summaryLines.join("\n");
}
